title: Next image after the NAT-084 finding: ADT /chosen/ephemeral-storage=1 (so keybagd --init skips instead of rebooting the system) plus one launchd job (/bin/ps -A to the console) in the small root; build, derive the session driver, analyser rows for the launchd stage, decision draft
acceptance: The ADT used by the image equals the pinned e1s.adt plus exactly one /chosen property ephemeral-storage = u32 1 (parsed back, tested); the payload builds through the NAT-083 chain with that single substitution counted.

The os_variant path is documented from the shared cache disassembly: hw.ephemeral_storage (sysctl, from the ADT) decides os_variant_uses_ephemeral_storage, which keybagd --init checks before MKB_INIT.

A session driver derived from NAT-083's by counted substitutions and an analyser for the launchd stage (keybag skipped, boot tasks reached, job spawned, launchd alive or not) tested over the real NAT-084 log; decision draft with hashes. Nothing here measures the phone.
steps: Build image and small root with one job
